gates.scope: Pantheon+ plus DES-Dovekie calibration/covariance ablation under one nuisance policy
gates.why_now: Modern SN re-calibration materially shifts Omega_m and the apparent preference for evolving dark energy; a legacy diagonal SN fit is no longer an adequate validation endpoint.
acceptance: Pantheon+ and DES-Dovekie are evaluated as separate named calibration variants
raw/vector and covariance provenance are hashed
full covariance dimensions match the fitted SN vector
same nuisance and absolute-magnitude treatment is used across LCDM, CPL and RLL
redshift-binned residual and Delta-chi2 diagnostics are emitted
diagonal-only output remains labeled exploratory

gates.scope: Nested-sampling evidence for LCDM, CPL and RLL with identical likelihood data and versioned priors
gates.why_now: Current literature demonstrates that frequentist Delta-chi2 and Bayesian model preference can move in different directions after the Ockham penalty and dataset-tension accounting.
acceptance: real nested sampling is executed; BIC proxy is not accepted
LCDM, CPL and RLL use the same materialized likelihood components
prior transforms and parameter ranges are versioned and hashed
logZ and numerical uncertainty are stored per model
Bayes factors are computed from stored logZ values
independent replication is recorded before scientific promotion

gates.scope: Reproduce official DESI DR2 benchmark products and tracer-level residuals before interpreting RLL deltas
gates.why_now: The repository has a tested 13x13 block construction, but that is not equivalent to the full official joint/cross-block likelihood or official chain reproduction.
acceptance: official DESI DR2 source products are identified by immutable hashes or provider identifiers
13 observable order and units are machine-checked
rd convention is explicit
LCDM and CPL reference results are reproduced within declared tolerance
per-tracer contributions expose whether LRG or Ly-alpha bins dominate a delta
block-diagonal fallback is never labeled official joint covariance

gates.scope: ACT DR6 TT/TE/EE likelihood or explicitly documented compressed equivalent
gates.why_now: ACT DR6 supplies an independent CMB likelihood with high-precision polarization and provides a stronger cross-check than a Planck-only compressed shift vector.
acceptance: likelihood release and spectra are versioned
foreground/nuisance treatment is explicit
LCDM reference parameters are reproduced within tolerance
same CMB treatment is used for CPL and RLL
compressed likelihood, if used, is labeled compressed rather than full

gates.scope: DES Y6 3x2pt growth/weak-lensing likelihood and S8 comparison
gates.why_now: DES Y6 is a current low-redshift structure benchmark and directly tests the growth sector that a background-only RLL fit cannot validate.
acceptance: DES Y6 source release and likelihood are versioned
scale cuts and nuisance parameters are recorded
S8 is derived from the same perturbation backend used by the model fit
LCDM reference is reproduced before RLL comparison
a point estimate without covariance is insufficient

gates.scope: Cross-backend perturbation benchmark for LCDM/CPL plus an explicit RLL perturbation contract
gates.why_now: CAMB v2 raises the numerical reference standard and stabilized PPF dark-energy evolution; CLASS remains an independent cross-check. Importability alone is not evidence.
acceptance: CLASS and CAMB versions and compile/runtime configuration are recorded
LCDM and CPL agree across backends within declared numerical tolerance
H(z), D+(z), f*sigma8, P(k,z) and applicable CMB spectra are compared
RLL perturbation equations, sound speed/anisotropic stress or PPF mapping are explicit
ghost/gradient or equivalent stability assumptions are documented
background agreement alone cannot close this gate

gates.scope: Formal H0 likelihood with modern SN calibration and explicit early/late-time separation
gates.why_now: A single fitted H0 value does not establish tension relief; the distance-ladder and CMB inferences depend on distinct assumptions and must be compared through versioned likelihoods.
acceptance: late-time and early-time likelihood sources are separately versioned
rd and calibration assumptions are explicit
Delta H0/sigma is computed under a declared model and covariance treatment
LCDM, CPL and RLL are compared under identical external likelihood choices
no resolution claim is made from a point estimate alone
